qaLog.question: What is v2's finish line before you narrate THIS video?
qaLog.answer: Narrate this video soon: fixed hook, takes you can stop/trim/redo in pieces, per-take volume, a visible timeline; filmstrip/waveforms, camera over time and timeline effects after

qaLog.question: What should the opening be?
qaLog.answer: Montage + voice, outcomes shown (3-4 best plays played through, swipes, voice carries the 10/0 stat and one credential sentence)
options: Keep the tease, play the best one through
Play both current clips to outcome

qaLog.question: What text pops over the montage?
How should fixing a take work?
qaLog.answer: Punch-in: pieces + trim + record-over replaces overlapped takes; no pause button

qaLog.question: Which extra take edits?
qaLog.answer: Split at the playhead; nudge (drag, capped ±3 s, offset shown); mute instead of delete

qaLog.question: Which lanes does the finished timeline have?
qaLog.answer: Frame strip; narration lane with waveforms; game audio lane; markers lane (chapters + cue sheet)

qaLog.question: What should playback in the page sound like before export?
qaLog.answer: Full mix in the browser (Web Audio: gains, trims, mutes, nudges, ducking)

qaLog.question: How do you want to control the game audio under your voice?
qaLog.answer: Regions on the game lane with a level each + one global duck slider
options: Global game level + duck knob only

qaLog.question: How should the camera box change over time?
qaLog.answer: Camera regions, hard switch; default box outside regions

qaLog.question: (not asked; owner left) Where are timeline effects applied?
qaLog.answer: Claude default: length-preserving effects + SFX in the narration export on the PC, stored in the session in joined-video seconds; length-changing edits stay story requests on the laptop; phase 3

qaLog.question: (not asked) How does a longer hook affect recorded takes?
qaLog.answer: Claude default: pin intro_s; offer 'shift takes by Δ and relock'
